checked_scope: Population envelope sharpness, signed-grid compatibility and conditional-bin confidence region
checks: Distance-envelope functions preserve common Lipschitz constant and interpolate observed support; clipping preserves range. A one-sign off-support contrast orders their integrals and convex mixtures attain the interval.

For signed grid contrasts, pairwise constraints are necessary: the review line example gives independent bound3/10 but compatible maximum1/10. Combining grid and support inequalities gives an extendable Lipschitz function, so the LP is sharp.

Conditional-bin Hoeffding plus Lh/2 center bias gives whole-kernel coverage. Two feasible functions differ at a center by <=2rmax+Lh, and moving to x adds <=2L(dist(x,S0)+h), yielding3Lh; the support-gap integral is d0*L*(1-a)^2.
